# censusindia

Digitised Census of India data from 1901 to 2011 for R. Population time
series, primary census abstracts, mother tongue tables, SC/ST and tribal
populations, linguistic diversity indices, MOHFW population projections
through 2036, and administrative directories at state, district, and
subdistrict levels.

## Installation

``` r

devtools::install_github("saketlab/censusindia")
```

## Quickstart

``` r

library(censusindia)

get_census(2011, "state")
get_census(1971, "district", state = "Maharashtra")
get_census(1971, "district", state = "MH", geometry = TRUE)

list_census_variables()
search_census_variables("literacy")
list_census_geographies()

# MOHFW population projections (2011-2036)
get_population(2031, "state")
get_population(2031, "district")
```

## Example

``` r

library(censusindia)
library(ggplot2)

mh <- get_census(1971, "district", state = "Maharashtra", geometry = TRUE)

ggplot(mh) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = population)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Population by district, Maharashtra 1971")
```

## Data source

Most datasets are derived from:

> Jolad, Shivakumar and Singh, Madhav (2026). “Indian Census Data
> Collection, 1901-2026: Digitised Subnational Population and
> Administrative Datasets.” Harvard Dataverse.
> <https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/ON8CP8>

The 2011 mother tongue data comes from the Census of India C-16 tables.

# Package index

## Census Datasets

Census data

- [`census_population_time_series`](https://saketlab.github.io/censusindia/reference/census_population_time_series.md)
  : Census population time series (1901-2011)
- [`census_1961_literacy`](https://saketlab.github.io/censusindia/reference/census_1961_literacy.md)
  : Census 1961 literacy data
- [`census_1971`](https://saketlab.github.io/censusindia/reference/census_1971.md)
  : Census 1971 Primary Census Abstract
- [`census_1981`](https://saketlab.github.io/censusindia/reference/census_1981.md)
  : Census 1981 Primary Census Abstract
- [`census_2011_pca`](https://saketlab.github.io/censusindia/reference/census_2011_pca.md)
  : Census 2011 Primary Census Abstract (PCA)
- [`census_2011_demographics`](https://saketlab.github.io/censusindia/reference/census_2011_demographics.md)
  : Census 2011 demographics (PCA)
- [`census_2011_workers`](https://saketlab.github.io/censusindia/reference/census_2011_workers.md)
  : Census 2011 workers (PCA)
- [`census_2011_marginal_detail`](https://saketlab.github.io/censusindia/reference/census_2011_marginal_detail.md)
  : Census 2011 marginal worker detail (PCA)
- [`census_2011_mother_tongue`](https://saketlab.github.io/censusindia/reference/census_2011_mother_tongue.md)
  : Census 2011 mother tongue data (C-16)
- [`census_2011_district_languages`](https://saketlab.github.io/censusindia/reference/census_2011_district_languages.md)
  : Census 2011 district languages (C-16)
- [`census_2011_subdistrict_languages`](https://saketlab.github.io/censusindia/reference/census_2011_subdistrict_languages.md)
  : Census 2011 subdistrict languages (C-16)
- [`census_2011_linguistic_diversity`](https://saketlab.github.io/censusindia/reference/census_2011_linguistic_diversity.md)
  : Census 2011 linguistic diversity
- [`census_2011_sc_st`](https://saketlab.github.io/censusindia/reference/census_2011_sc_st.md)
  : Census 2011 Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (A-10/A-11)
- [`census_2011_tribes`](https://saketlab.github.io/censusindia/reference/census_2011_tribes.md)
  : Census 2011 Scheduled Tribes (A-11)
- [`census_subdistricts_2011`](https://saketlab.github.io/censusindia/reference/census_subdistricts_2011.md)
  : Subdistrict directory (2011)
- [`census_variables`](https://saketlab.github.io/censusindia/reference/census_variables.md)
  : Census variables lookup
- [`india_states`](https://saketlab.github.io/censusindia/reference/india_states.md)
  : Indian states lookup

## Population Projections

MOHFW population projections (2011-2036)

- [`get_population()`](https://saketlab.github.io/censusindia/reference/get_population.md)
  : Get population projections
- [`population_projections_state`](https://saketlab.github.io/censusindia/reference/population_projections_state.md)
  : Population projections – state level (2011-2036)
- [`population_projections_district`](https://saketlab.github.io/censusindia/reference/population_projections_district.md)
  : Population projections – district level, Census 2011 boundaries
  (2011-2031)
- [`population_projections_district_lgd`](https://saketlab.github.io/censusindia/reference/population_projections_district_lgd.md)
  : Population projections – district level, LGD boundaries (2012-2031)

## Census Data Access

Retrieve census datasets

- [`get_census()`](https://saketlab.github.io/censusindia/reference/get_census.md)
  : Get India census data

## Geographic Boundaries

Administrative boundaries

- [`get_census_boundaries()`](https://saketlab.github.io/censusindia/reference/get_census_boundaries.md)
  : Get census boundaries
- [`attach_geometry()`](https://saketlab.github.io/censusindia/reference/attach_geometry.md)
  : Attach geographic boundaries to census data
- [`clear_geometry_cache()`](https://saketlab.github.io/censusindia/reference/clear_geometry_cache.md)
  : Clear geometry cache

## Mapping & Visualization

Choropleth maps

- [`plotting`](https://saketlab.github.io/censusindia/reference/plotting.md)
  : Plotting functions for census data
- [`plot_map()`](https://saketlab.github.io/censusindia/reference/plot_map.md)
  : Create a choropleth map from census data.
- [`compare_maps()`](https://saketlab.github.io/censusindia/reference/compare_maps.md)
  : Compare maps across years
- [`get_palette()`](https://saketlab.github.io/censusindia/reference/get_palette.md)
  : Get color palette

## Variable Discovery

Available census variables

- [`list_census_variables()`](https://saketlab.github.io/censusindia/reference/list_census_variables.md)
  : List census variables
- [`list_census_geographies()`](https://saketlab.github.io/censusindia/reference/list_census_geographies.md)
  : List available census geographies
- [`list_states()`](https://saketlab.github.io/censusindia/reference/list_states.md)
  : List Indian states
- [`search_census_variables()`](https://saketlab.github.io/censusindia/reference/search_census_variables.md)
  : Search census variables
